_comment: Bundler-first, emit-free baseline. Nothing in this monorepo is compiled by tsc:
apps/web is built by Vite, and the internal packages are consumed as TypeScript
source (just-in-time packages), so every config here is set to typecheck only.
Typechecking runs through tsgo (@typescript/native-preview), not tsc.
`types` is set explicitly (and never left to auto-discovery) because TypeScript
6/7 no longer pulls every node_modules/@types package into the program, and
because `exclude` in an extended config resolves relative to THIS file, not to
the consumer — so scoping is done with each package's own `include` instead.
